claims.quote: Identification of clinically relevant allergens facilitates targeted environmental avoidance and consideration of allergen immunotherapy.

claims.text: AR w inadequate response to meds: offer (or refer for) sublingual or SC immunotherapy
claims.quote: Clinicians should offer, or refer to a clinician who can offer, immunotherapy (sublingual or subcutaneous) for patients with AR who have inadequate response to symptoms with pharmacologic therapy
claims.locator: Seidman MD, et al. Clinical practice guideline: Allergic rhinitis. Otolaryngol Head Neck Surg. 2015;152(1 Suppl):S1-S43 (abstract, PubMed)
